key_insight: A metric space $Z$ gives rise to three natural classes of infinite-dimensional metric spaces associated to $Z$: $p$-Wasserstein spaces of probability measures on $Z$, nonlinear Lebesgue $L^p$-spaces of $Z$-valued maps, and $p$-Gromov-Wasserstein spaces of $Z$-
